evidence.detail: The class owns one static List<Sprite>. Its path-taking factory constructs a new R55 Sprite, stores the supplied resource path on that Sprite and appends the same object to the registry before returning it.

The no-arg static reload walks every registered Sprite, loads its path-backed AWT image, recalculates width/height/offset state, allocates the exact pixel array and fills it through PixelGrabber, including the Sprite color-key cleanup path.
Client invokes the registry materialization method once during its shared asset startup sequence after static sprite-holder classes have registered resources.

R308 CombatHudSpriteAssets registers exact paths including misc/singlesplus, misc/singlesplushot, popups/hp 0..3, hitmarks/old/poise and popups/scope through this registry, fixing the role to path-backed Sprite resource registration/materialization.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the global path-backed Sprite registration and startup materialization registry. No original stripped identifier is claimed.
